notes: extractor: The two listed 2026 calls are separate route choices: small grants closed on 2026-06-03 and large grants closed on 2026-04-19. Small grants use PROSAS and do not require a full proposal; large grants use ConservationGrants and may invite a full proposal. The large-call page lists a budget template, but the supplied text does not state that it is submitted at the first step.
